summary: Learn Social Accountability and Community Scorecard Training with scorecards, interface meetings, and reporting templates. Book your 5-day course today.
lede: Social accountability and community scorecards provide a structured way to compare community and provider views of services and turn findings into follow-up actions. Designed for practitioners and managers working with community programmes or public services, the training covers scorecard criteria and measurement, interface meeting facilitation, and tracking commitments through action registers and reporting templates.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to run community scorecard processes, manage citizen feedback, and document service improvements with evidence. It suits practitioners, managers, specialists, and leaders working across public services, development programmes, and community accountability initiatives. Social Accountability Officers managing community feedback and follow-up. Monitoring and Evaluation Specialists tracking service performance and evidence. Community Engagement Coordinators facilitating scorecard exercises and dialogue. Public Sector Programme Managers overseeing accountability reforms. NGO Field Leads organizing interface meetings and community mobilization. Governance Advisers linking citizen feedback to reporting chains. Public Service Delivery Officers responding to scorecard commitments. Citizen Participation Specialists supporting inclusive accountability processes. Project Officers documenting action points and implementation status. Programme Accountability Coordinators maintaining scorecard records and dashboards.
prerequisites: You will need a laptop, a spreadsheet tool such as Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, and access to simple survey or note-taking software for practical exercises. A current programme or service case from your work will help you complete the applied scorecard and reporting activities more effectively.
